name: FTLE-based Quad Size Estimation
definition: A method to determine quad sizes that guarantees complete covering of isosurfaces by estimating the separation factor between seeds using Finite-Time Lyapunov Exponent (FTLE) concepts from dynamical systems theory.
summary: FTLE-based Quad Size Estimation determines conservative quad sizes for isosurface rendering by estimating separation factors along gradient field lines to guarantee complete surface coverage.
